headline: St. Mary's put ten past Sul Ross State
dek: St. Mary's had scored three goals in their first three matches and lost two of them. Sul Ross State have now lost all four of theirs, and their keeper Fernando Hernandez has made twenty-six saves without a clean sheet.
displaced_by: St. Mary's ten goals against Sul Ross State; the standing dek's claim that West Texas A&M's eleven conceded were matched only by Sul Ross State no longer holds

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Eight different players have scored Midwestern State's fourteen goals, and Jose Ortiz has five of them.

wire.line: Sul Ross State have conceded twenty-one goals in four matches and are yet to score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no result published, among them Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, and St. Edward's against Southwestern.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian have won three and lost two, and both defeats have come away from home, at Northeastern State and Rogers State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas have won three, drawn one and lost one, and their ten goals are more than Lubbock Christian and West Texas A&M have scored together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Texas A&M International have won two and drawn one, and have conceded a single goal.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Midwestern State have won both matches at home and drawn both away, scoring fourteen and conceding four.

last_match.line: St. Mary's have now won as many as they have lost, and Sul Ross State are still without a goal of their own.

next_match.line: Midwestern State have yet to lose; Southern Nazarene have already beaten West Texas A&M this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
